connectors.name: Acervo Sonarview
connectors.description: Searches the public Acervo Sonarview library of reports, surveys, case studies and regulations for strategic planning and reads documents with source links.
connectors.use_case: Finding retail market studies for a 2027 plan, reading a regulation cited in a credit strategy.

connectors.name: AgingResearch.News
connectors.description: Searches and lists new aging and age-related disease research from bioRxiv, medRxiv, PubMed, arXiv and Europe PMC with structured evidence on drugs, genes and processes, and lists stories, clinical trials, NIH, EU, UKRI and Wellcome grants, conference abstracts, industry news and therapy programmes, with topic following for signed-in accounts.
connectors.use_case: Reviewing the cross-species evidence on a longevity drug candidate, finding recent NIH grants on cellular senescence, following a gene to track new papers on it.

connectors.name: Ai Lately
connectors.description: Searches Ai Lately's AI industry reporting for source-linked passages, builds sourced briefs on AI people and companies, fetches article excerpts and corrections and lists developments from the last 14 days.
connectors.use_case: Preparing a brief on a chief scientist before an interview, listing AI hiring moves announced this week.

connectors.name: Ajel Wire
connectors.description: Searches Ajel newspaper reporting by headline or summary, retrieves the latest articles and breaking news from the past 72 hours, reads full articles with original links and published translations in 10 languages.
connectors.use_case: Reading this morning's Saudi breaking news in English, finding Ajel coverage of a Riyadh metro line opening.

connectors.name: AlphaSights
connectors.description: Searches AlphaSights expert call transcripts and the research library to summarize recent calls and test investment theses, for individuals with an AlphaSights account.
connectors.use_case: Summarizing recent expert calls on a topic, testing an investment thesis against call transcripts.

connectors.name: alphaXiv
connectors.description: Searches millions of arXiv papers by keyword, full text and embedding similarity, retrieves papers for a research question, reads paper content, answers questions about paper PDFs and reads files from GitHub.
connectors.use_case: Finding and reading arXiv papers on a topic, searching paper full text for a method, keeping up with the latest research.

connectors.name: American Default Research
connectors.description: Searches public economic indicators on US household financial distress, returns dated readings with sources, county distress scorecards, cross-correlations and the American Distress Index with its breakdown.
connectors.use_case: Pulling the distress scorecard for Wayne County, Michigan, comparing credit card delinquency with the index since 2020.

connectors.name: AnswerThis
connectors.description: Searches academic papers, reads saved AnswerThis library papers and full text, saves papers, creates and revises Writer drafts with citations, and runs systematic review screening and extraction jobs.
connectors.use_case: Finding recent trials on intermittent fasting and HbA1c, screening 300 abstracts against inclusion criteria, drafting a cited related-work section.

connectors.name: Apprised.news
connectors.description: Reads Apprised.news AI-written desk briefs and daily intelligence reports, pulls recent third-party headlines and searches the site, read-only.
connectors.use_case: Reading today's Daily Intelligence Report, searching briefs that mention a shipping strike.

connectors.name: AppTierList
connectors.description: Searches AppTierList's rankings of iPhone and iPad apps by use case, each tiered S to F from public App Store data, compares apps, explains rankings, finds alternatives and lists recent changes.
connectors.use_case: Finding the S-tier budgeting apps, comparing two meditation apps, checking alternatives to a photo editor that went subscription-only.

connectors.name: Arpany Research AI
connectors.description: Searches quality-filtered scientific papers, writes literature reviews with each claim tied to a DOI, answers questions about a paper, analyzes citations and trends, finds authors and institutions and formats citations in six styles.
connectors.use_case: Writing a review of perovskite solar cell stability since 2022, formatting 15 references in APA, finding the institutions publishing most on battery research.

connectors.name: Arpelier
connectors.description: Validates and computes semiconductor process flows in Arpelier, inspects the resulting 3D device structures, takes cross sections, exports structures, reads docs and opens flows in the app.
connectors.use_case: Checking a FinFET flow with deposition, lithography and etch steps, taking a cross section after the gate etch.

connectors.name: Ask Pandi
connectors.description: Runs a research question through Pandi and returns an answer with numbered citations and source links, follows an answer while it is being researched, and picks it back up after reconnecting, with guest access that needs no Pandi account.
connectors.use_case: Asking a research question and checking each numbered citation against its linked source.

connectors.name: Atomscale
connectors.description: Search, analyze, and build insights from materials science and engineering data.
connectors.use_case: Extracting information from synthesis and characterization data, analyzing materials-processing datasets, accelerating materials research.

connectors.name: Audioscrape
connectors.description: Search everything said in podcasts, government meetings, and your own recordings — with speaker attribution, exact timestamps, and links that jump to the moment it was said.
connectors.use_case: Finding the exact moment a city council member mentioned a budget item, pulling every quote a specific guest gave across several podcast episodes.

connectors.name: Bible Ontology
connectors.description: Queries a Bible knowledge graph of people, events, places and ideas, where each link names its supporting verse, confidence level and speaker, and reads verses and Hebrew or Greek words, read-only.
connectors.use_case: Tracing every event linked to Barnabas with its verses, checking how a Greek word for grace is used.

connectors.name: BioSkepsis
connectors.description: Run a full life-science literature review inside Claude and get back a citation-grounded, trust-scored brief.
connectors.use_case: Getting a trust-scored brief on a specific gene therapy before a grant application, checking the citation grounding behind a claim in a paper draft.

connectors.name: BrainConnect
connectors.description: Finds industry practitioners for research interviews, returning an anonymized expert shortlist and registering an interview request after explicit confirmation.
connectors.use_case: Sourcing experts for a due diligence project, shortlisting practitioners for a market study, submitting preferred interview times.

connectors.name: Brieflands
connectors.description: Searches and reads peer-reviewed open-access articles in Brieflands journals, browses journals and issues, finds citing and similar articles, formats citations and checks reference lists for retractions and corrections.
connectors.use_case: Finding recent studies on probiotics and gut health, checking a manuscript's reference list for retracted papers.

connectors.name: Carbon of Compute
connectors.description: Estimates the carbon and water footprint of AI language models per 1,000 output tokens or per task, ranks models, and returns manufacturing footprints of accelerators, servers and facilities.
connectors.use_case: Comparing the carbon footprint of 1 million output tokens across three models.

connectors.name: Cassandra
connectors.description: Reads Cassandra's dated forecasts with probabilities and deadlines on news events, Brazilian stocks and cryptocurrencies, and the public scorecard of past forecast results.
connectors.use_case: Checking the forecast odds on a Brazilian political story this week, reviewing how accurate last month's crypto forecasts were.

connectors.name: Causal Mechanism Registry
connectors.description: Searches and resolves names in a versioned registry of causal mechanisms behind financial, economic and political crises, famines, epidemics and wars, returning each entry's definition, scope, boundary and test with version history and citations.
connectors.use_case: Checking whether a 2023 regional bank failure fits the bank-run mechanism, citing the registry's definition of a sovereign debt crisis in a policy brief.

connectors.name: Chart to Data
connectors.description: Reads every chart drawn in a PDF at a given web address and returns its axes, series, points and error bars as data taken from the drawing itself.
connectors.use_case: Extracting the dose-response values from figure 3 of a pharmacology paper, pulling bar chart figures from an annual report PDF.

connectors.name: Cheméo, Chemical and Physical Properties
connectors.description: Searches chemical compounds by name, formula, CAS number, InChI or SMILES and returns around 130 sourced thermophysical properties, including temperature-dependent tables, estimates key properties from structure, and gives UNIFAC, UNIQUAC and Joback group assignments.
connectors.use_case: Pulling vapor pressure data for toluene across a temperature range to fit a correlation, checking ethanol's flash point and flammability limits for a safety review, estimating the boiling point of a molecule missing from the database.

connectors.name: Christian Open Library
connectors.description: Searches 7,700+ public-domain Christian books and historic denominational records by meaning and exact words, reads passages and scripture, finds works and scripture citations, defines terms and checks quotations.
connectors.use_case: Finding what Augustine wrote about grace in City of God, checking the exact wording of a Spurgeon quote before a sermon.

connectors.name: Chronicle Makers Tools
connectors.description: Sorts, checks and plans genealogy research from member-supplied record transcriptions and working files, finding every form of an ancestor's name, separating same-name people, listing associates and neighbors, drafting research plans and reviewing conclusions against sources, plus guided workflows for research logs, record types, places and family charts.
connectors.use_case: Sorting record abstracts for two men with the same name into separate people, building a research plan for a great-grandmother's missing marriage record.

connectors.name: Citation Library
connectors.description: Looks up DOIs, ISBNs, arXiv and PubMed ids or titles as verified references, keeps them in libraries and exports BibTeX, RIS or formatted lists.
connectors.use_case: Building an APA reference list from ten DOIs for a thesis chapter.

connectors.name: Citeproof
connectors.description: Verifies academic references by matching bibliographies, DOIs, arXiv IDs or PMIDs against Crossref, DataCite, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar, reporting matched metadata, confidence scores and retraction flags, finds abstract sentences related to a claim, and exports checks as Markdown, CSV or BibTeX.
connectors.use_case: Checking a manuscript's reference list for fabricated citations, finding sentences in a paper's abstract that relate to a specific claim.

connectors.name: citetex.com
connectors.description: Searches OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, Crossref, Europe PMC and CORE for papers with BibTeX entries, and reads, edits, creates and compiles LaTeX projects in a CiteTex account.
connectors.use_case: Adding verified references on graph neural networks to a thesis bibliography, fixing a compile error a chapter throws, starting a new conference paper project.

connectors.name: Citrello
connectors.description: Searches a personal Citrello reference library, adds references from a DOI, link or typed reference and rates each against Crossref, reads papers' full text to find the passage behind a sentence, formats references in 10,000+ citation styles, writes Word documents with live citations, and gives BibTeX, checks LaTeX citations and prepares arXiv-ready .zip files, while Citrello is open on the computer or in a browser tab.
connectors.use_case: Checking that a cited paper really says what a sentence claims, formatting a reference list in Vancouver, preparing a LaTeX project for arXiv.

connectors.name: Classic Literature
connectors.description: Measures classic novels from their full texts, returning emotional arcs, genre history, author influence chains and writers with similar prose across 339 public-domain novels.
connectors.use_case: Seeing how Moby-Dick's mood shifts from opening to ending, finding writers whose prose sounds most like Melville.

connectors.name: Climate Insights Directory
connectors.description: Searches an open index of over 40,000 climate and energy reports, policy briefs and analyses by civil society organizations worldwide, such as NGOs, think tanks and research centers, filtering by publisher, geography, topic, document type, language and date, and returns records with summaries, metadata and links to the original publisher.
connectors.use_case: Finding think-tank briefs on coal phase-out in Southeast Asia, gathering NGO analyses of adaptation finance, putting a recent flood in context of earlier research for a news story.

connectors.name: Colaunched
connectors.description: Searches, saves and reads business ideas scored for demand, timing, market gap, personal fit and difficulty, with their evidence, tracks a 90-day launch plan's steps and gates, and writes an evidence pack for customers, partners or banks.
connectors.use_case: Comparing two saved ideas by fit and difficulty, checking which launch steps are overdue, preparing an evidence pack before a bank meeting.

connectors.name: Collision CoPilot
connectors.description: Answers collision repair questions with cited text from BainbridgeAI playbooks, Database Enhancement Gateway inquiries, NHTSA recalls, complaints and VIN decoding, US federal law, and state law for California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Michigan, Montana, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas and Washington.
connectors.use_case: Finding the DEG ruling on a not-included refinish operation, checking open recalls for a VIN, citing state law in an insurer dispute.

connectors.name: CommentMetro
connectors.description: Reads CommentMetro comments and replies left by people and AI agents on public web pages, and searches recent conversations.
connectors.use_case: Reading what readers said about a library's migration guide before relying on it, searching discussions about a product launch this week.

connectors.name: Commonplace
connectors.description: Searches more than 1,200 public-domain works of Reformed and Puritan theology, reads passages and scripture citations, and quotes them exactly with edition and page number.
connectors.use_case: Finding where John Owen discusses Hebrews 6, quoting a Calvin passage on prayer with page number for a sermon.

connectors.name: ConductScience Catalog
connectors.description: Searches the public ConductScience catalog of laboratory equipment and research software by name, SKU or research need, returning specifications, product pages and listed prices.
connectors.use_case: Finding a rotarod for mouse motor studies, comparing benchtop centrifuge specifications, checking the listed price of a maze apparatus.

connectors.name: Corroborum

connectors.use_case: Finding highly cited open-access papers on microplastics in drinking water, tracing which later studies cite a landmark paper, excluding retracted work from a literature list.

connectors.name: Cypris Q
connectors.description: Researches patents, scientific literature, chemical compounds, and technical markets, returning cited reports on prior art, freedom to operate, and trends.
connectors.use_case: Running a prior art search before filing, mapping the competitive landscape for a new material, spotting whitespace in a technology area.

connectors.name: Data Butler
connectors.description: Returns sourced reference data with verification dates, including UK tax-year rates and thresholds, AQA GCSE topic-to-paper mappings, domain and npm or PyPI package provenance, exact statistical calculations and official vehicle recall and MOT data, plus figures changed since a date.
connectors.use_case: Checking the current UK National Insurance threshold, confirming which GCSE Physics paper covers radioactivity, vetting an npm package for typosquatting.

connectors.name: DataCNVS
connectors.description: Builds and edits DataCNVS scientific plots, configuring axes, series and multi-panel layouts, overlaying runs, adding callouts, region markers and threshold lines, and applying themes.
connectors.use_case: Overlaying stress-strain curves from 25 to 800 degrees C, applying a lab theme to 10 canvases from last month.

connectors.name: Dewey Data
connectors.description: Searches Dewey Platform datasets by keyword or meaning and returns dataset details, coverage summaries, schemas, documentation, related datasets, data partners, samples and download information for academic research.
connectors.use_case: Looking for a dataset to test a hypothesis before writing a paper, finding data to support a grant proposal's methods section.

connectors.name: Digital in Asia
connectors.description: Searches Digital in Asia analysis on AI, gaming, ecommerce and payments in Asia, and returns market trackers, country profiles, market comparisons, report summaries and glossary terms with sources and dates.
connectors.use_case: Comparing digital payments adoption in Vietnam and Indonesia, summarizing the free Southeast Asia ecommerce report.

connectors.name: Dimenso AI
connectors.description: Reads Dimenso lab records, including sessions with transcripts, timelines, protocol steps, measurements, plates, deviations and media, plus protocols, reports, results, datasets and files.
connectors.use_case: Finding deviations from last Thursday's PCR session, pulling plate measurements for a project report.

connectors.name: Domandata

connectors.name: Dscout Researcher
connectors.description: Drafts and launches Dscout research studies, pulls participant responses for analysis, and looks up participant profiles, submissions, and quality signals.

connectors.name: EasyExpert
connectors.description: Asks the EasyExpert network or one circle of experts, finds experts by topic, and lets experts create, publish, test and update their knowledge.
connectors.use_case: Asking the tax circle about VAT on digital services in Spain, publishing a consultant's notes as an expert.

connectors.name: Elicit
connectors.description: Searches a corpus of over 125 million academic papers, searches trials, and creates and retrieves structured reports that extract and synthesize data across papers.
connectors.use_case: Surveying the literature on a research question, building a report that extracts and compares findings across studies, searching for related trials.

connectors.name: Emerge Times
connectors.description: Lists, searches and reads published Emerge Times articles on AI agents, AGI, robotics and the agent economy, with source links and citation lines.
connectors.use_case: Finding recent Emerge Times articles on AI agents and online shopping with their sources.

connectors.name: Episto
connectors.description: Runs qualitative and quantitative studies on Episto, recruiting respondents, engaging them in an interactive format, and analyzing the results.

connectors.name: Farside Research

connectors.name: fastCRW
connectors.description: Searches the web and reads public pages as clean markdown with source links, maps a site's URLs, crawls sites with status checks, and extracts structured data from pages.

connectors.name: fastwrite

connectors.name: FireAI

connectors.name: Flevy

connectors.name: GimmeTheSauce
connectors.description: Searches the GimmeTheSauce library of what app and SaaS founders published about launching, pricing and growth, by founder, product or topic, and finds founders, with source links.

connectors.name: Heystack
connectors.description: Searches and reads Heystack's public library of living Markdown documents and spreadsheets by section, lists topics, and shows revision history and moderated discussion, returning a citation with each read.
connectors.use_case: Finding a community checklist for SOC 2 readiness and citing the exact revision used.

connectors.name: HFS Research
connectors.description: Searches HFS Research reports, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, and quick takes for authenticated members, returning cited passages with source, author, date, and link.
connectors.use_case: Finding what analysts published on a vendor this quarter, pulling the passage behind a claim with its citation, browsing the latest quick takes by topic.

connectors.use_case: Adding a new accession of oak seedlings from a seed exchange, listing materials moved to the glasshouse this month.

connectors.description: Counts and lists notable people's births, deaths, burials and visits by place, role, year, span of years, text or distance from a point, returning matching people with birth and death years, moment texts and credited pictures.

connectors.name: Hyperresearch Answers

connectors.name: Inciteful

connectors.name: INDXR

connectors.name: Insight Maker
connectors.description: Lists, reads, previews, creates and edits Insight Maker simulation models, including System Dynamics, agent-based and differential equation models.
connectors.use_case: Building a stock-and-flow model of a town's water reservoir, running a predator-prey model for a class.

connectors.name: Janus

connectors.name: JurnalHub

connectors.name: JustSeeItAll
connectors.description: Returns English summaries of published reporting, ideas and culture from sources across countries, filterable by country and topic, with credited original publishers, source links, source dates and access to hourly archives.

connectors.name: KleisUp

connectors.name: KORE

connectors.name: Kosmico

connectors.name: Lacuna Research

connectors.use_case: Mapping the research directions around diffusion model distillation, finding researchers similar to a given author, locating the code repository for a paper.

connectors.name: Lumiere
connectors.description: Searches a video library's transcripts and moments, analyzes viewer feedback, and compares engagement data across videos in a Lumiere workspace.

connectors.name: Lune

connectors.use_case: Gathering prior work before writing a related-work section, checking how a method was evaluated, choosing a venue for a submission.

connectors.name: makepublish
connectors.description: Searches papers across PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Crossref with title, first author, year, journal and link, gauges how much is written on a question and finds research gaps, saves papers to the makepublish Library or a research project, and starts research, sets its question, moves phases, assigns tasks and makes invite links under the leader's rules, saying what it will do before making, assigning or deleting anything.

connectors.name: Mantic

connectors.name: Manulyx

connectors.use_case: Tightening a paper's abstract, fixing a LaTeX compile error, adding a citation by DOI in the document's existing style.

connectors.name: Manusights

connectors.name: Marginalia Corpus
